observations.fact: During architecture discussion, focus shifted from the complete Project Foundry pipeline to building a minimal Foundry Kernel.
observations.impact: The owner identified a risk of forgetting the original objective and later forgetting the reduced interpretation as well.
observations.interpretation: A current technical subproblem can replace the full objective when North Star, program, scope, and task are not shown together.

observations.fact: The owner required every important implementation action to compare feasible methods before selection.
observations.impact: Decision Intelligence became a required cross-cutting pipeline rather than an informal recommendation.
observations.interpretation: Method selection must be explicit, evidence-based, weighted, and adapted to AI operation.

lesson_candidates.statement: Always display North Star, full Program, active Scope, and current Task as a single context path.
Important implementation methods must pass a Decision Intelligence Gate that includes AI operability and owner usability.
